data.name: Codex-Named Unit (ability_inner_sea_gods_isg_abilities_faith_lst_99)
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, as a full-round action, you transform a single serving of an alcoholic beverage into either potent holy water or a potion of cure serious wounds. A potion created in this way heals 3d8+%1 points of damage. The holy water you create is more potent than usual, dealing 4d4 points of damage to an undead creature or evil outsider, and 2d4 points of splash damage to each such creature within 5 feet of the point where the flask hits. Holy water and potions created in this way last for 1 hour. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|min(15,TL)|max(1,CHA)
